push.title: D 3-3 vs Dark Hallow | You: 8.9
push.body:
An 8.9 against Dark Hallow, PhogsToffees. That's the good stuff, the kind you tell your dog about on the drive home.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at Dark Hallow's goal. You weren't shy, and shy doesn't score.
+ 3 key passes. Making chances is a gift, and you were Santa Claus tonight.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 5. You can build a whole match on that.
+ Giveaways 6, down from your usual 14. Little things like that are big things in disguise.
+ You and BellyTb1 speak the same football language.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Best practice: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
- Tackles attempted 1, down from your usual 6. Try it this way: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
- You and Soup_Kitchen22 were both flagged for shot selection. Fix it as a pair: cut it back to each other.
- On-ball actions 33, down from your usual 45. It happens. It can't keep happening.

Quick drill: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

PhogsToffees, something I want you to sleep on: Pressure is a privilege. It means you're playing for something.

You're making believers out of everybody. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 3-3 vs Dark Hallow | You: 6.6 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Well I'll be. Soup_Kitchen22, a 6.6. You played like the main character tonight.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against Dark Hallow, your 2nd straight match scoring. Ball in the net, smile on my face. That's the deal.
+ A 6.6, your best match performance of the season. You're raising your own bar.
+ Giveaways 5, down from your usual 7. I see you, and I like what I see.
+ Missed tackles 1, down from your usual 2. Proof you've got another gear.
+ 3 goals conceded put +0.1 on the board for you.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Here's what helps: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. That's a coach's honest word.
- Their best forward posted 9.5 to your 6.6. That's where the match slipped.
- PhogsToffees and you both slipped on shot selection. Catch each other: cut it back to each other.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was PhogsToffees's 2). Not who you are, but it was who showed up.

THE UGLY
! 56% passing (5 of 9). That's the first thing we fix, before anything else. Here's the fix: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

Practice prescription: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

Between you and me, Soup_Kitchen22: Smile at the goalkeeper. It confuses 'em.

That deserves a slow clap. - Coach Lasso
